structure: The backlog has ids and cross-links but no source quotes or locators: nothing links a story or question back to a PRD requirement number or sentence, and the PRD clauses are only paraphrased in readiness notes. I observe no review record (no independent reviewer field, no review status) and no machine-checked invariants or schema checks in the file. Readiness is expressed as booleans with free-text notes, and blocking questions link to work through affects lists, with dependency edges only for Q1 and Q2. Assumptions and inferred criteria are not marked by source, so the reader cannot tell which criteria come from the PRD and which were added. Counts here are by manual reading; where a judgment was close (H03 coverage, S4 readiness scope, severity of A2 and A6), it is noted above.
